_comment: URL knowledge: link shorteners, and the ports a normal web link uses.
A shortener is not malicious - it is *opaque*, which is the point. A recipient
cannot see where it goes, and neither can a rule, so the finding is 'the
destination is hidden', not 'the destination is bad'. Weighted accordingly, and it
is one of the few indicators the optional fetch can actually resolve.
`open_redirect_hosts` are legitimate domains with well-known redirect endpoints.
A link to one of these looks reassuring in a mail client while landing anywhere,
which is precisely why it is worth flagging.
